quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part you can feel go thump, thump, thump if you rest your hand on your chest?
quests.question: Heart
quests.hint: It is about the size of your fist.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Heart beats inside your chest and pumps blood all around your body!
quests.funFact: Your heart is roughly the same size as your own fist.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that fills up when you eat a tasty snack -- it is also the one that rumbles loudly when you are hungry!
quests.question: Tummy
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It rumbles when you are hungry!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Tummy is the middle of your body that helps digest the food you eat!
quests.funFact: Your tummy growls when it is empty because air is moving inside it!

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part found safely inside your head, protected by your skull?
quests.question: Brain
quests.hint: It is safe inside your head.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Brain helps you think, learn, and remember new things!
quests.funFact: Your brain sends messages to every single part of your body.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that forms the ticklish spot under your raised arm!
quests.question: Armpits
quests.hint: Hint: Your arms rest against these when they hang down.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Armpits are the spot right under your arms, where your arms meet your body!
quests.funFact: Your armpits are right where your arm joins your body.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that feels scratchy if you have a cold!
quests.question: Throat
quests.hint: Hint: Food travels through here on its way to your tummy.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Throat helps you swallow food and lets your voice come out!
quests.funFact: Your throat is a busy pathway for both food and air.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that lets you bend forward, backward, and side to side?
quests.question: Backbone
quests.hint: It helps you bend and stand up tall.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Backbone is the row of bones down your back that helps you stand tall and bend!
quests.funFact: Your backbone protects a bundle of nerves that runs all through it.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part found where your fingers bend, along the back of your hand!
quests.question: Knuckles
quests.hint: Hint: They are on the back of your hand, where your fingers bend.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Knuckles are the small joints that let your fingers bend and curl!
quests.funFact: You use your knuckles every time you knock on a door.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part where you might wear a fun pair of socks!
quests.question: Ankles
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You bend these when you point your toes.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Ankles connect your feet to your legs and help you balance!
quests.funFact: You use your ankles every time you jump or hop.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that a doctor can see clearly using a special X-ray picture?
quests.question: Bones
quests.hint: A doctor can see these with an X-ray.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Bones are the hard parts inside your body that hold you up and give you shape!
quests.funFact: Babies are born with about three hundred bones, and some join together as they grow.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part we rest against a chair when we sit down!
quests.question: Back
quests.hint: Here's a tip: You lie on this to look up at the sky.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Back is the part behind you that helps you stand up straight!
quests.funFact: Your back helps you stand up tall and straight.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that sneezes loudly when it feels tickly!
quests.question: Nose
quests.hint: You breathe air in and out through it.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Nose helps you smell and breathe in fresh air!
quests.funFact: Sneezing helps your nose clear away dust and germs.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that a dentist checks to keep healthy and strong!
quests.question: Teeth
quests.hint: They are hard, white, and live inside your mouth.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Teeth help you bite and chew your food!
quests.funFact: Your teeth start growing even before you are born, hidden under your gums!

quests.instruction: Show me the body part that wrinkles up when you feel confused!
quests.question: Forehead
quests.hint: Here's a tip: It gets wrinkly when you look puzzled.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Forehead is the flat part of your face above your eyebrows!
quests.funFact: Your forehead protects the front part of your skull underneath.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part we use to say hello to a friend!
quests.question: Mouth
quests.hint: Your teeth and tongue live inside it.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Mouth helps you eat, talk, and smile!
quests.funFact: Your lips and mouth work together every time you blow a big bubble with gum.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part you bend when you sit criss-cross on the floor!
quests.question: Knees
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are between your hip and your ankle.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Knees are the bendy joints in the middle of your legs!
quests.funFact: A small round bone called the kneecap protects the front of each knee.

quests.instruction: Show me the body part that sits right above each of your eyes!
quests.question: Eyebrows
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They are small, thin lines of hair above your eyes.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Eyebrows sit above your eyes and help keep sweat and rain out of them!
quests.funFact: Each eyebrow has its own special curved shape.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you stomp on the ground when you feel excited!
quests.question: Feet
quests.hint: They are found at the end of your legs.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Feet help you stand, walk, and run!
quests.funFact: Most people's two feet are a tiny bit different in size from each other!

quests.instruction: Show me the body part you blink to keep dust out of your eyes!
quests.question: Eyelashes
quests.hint: Here's a tip: They help keep dust out of your eyes.
quests.explanation: You got it! Your Eyelashes grow along your eyelids and help keep dust out of your eyes!
quests.funFact: Eyelashes grow, fall out, and grow back again on their own.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that swings side to side when you dance and touch it!
quests.question: Hips
quests.hint: Think about this: They are below your waist.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Hips are where your legs connect to your body, and help your legs swing!
quests.funFact: Hips let your legs swing forward, backward, and side to side.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you close tight when you play hide and seek!
quests.question: Eyes
quests.hint: Close these and everything turns dark.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Eyes help you see everything around you, like colors and shapes!
quests.funFact: Your two eyes work as a team to help you judge how far away things are.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that makes up your leg between your hip and your knee and touch it!
quests.question: Thighs
quests.hint: Think about this: They are between your hip and your knee.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Thighs are the top part of your leg, between your hip and your knee!
quests.funFact: Your thighs help you pedal a bike and climb up stairs.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that forms a hard, smooth tip at the end of each toe and touch it!
quests.question: Toenails
quests.hint: Think about this: You trim these to keep them short too.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Toenails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each toe and protects it!
quests.funFact: Toenails protect your toes when you take every step.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that moves up and down when you chew your food and touch it!
quests.question: Jaw
quests.hint: Think about this: Your bottom teeth are held inside it.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Jaw moves up and down to help you chew and talk!
quests.funFact: Your jaw moves every time you talk, chew, or yawn.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you use to feel cool sand at the beach!
quests.question: Toes
quests.hint: They are found at the end of your feet.
quests.explanation: Fantastic! Your Toes help you balance and push off the ground when you walk!
quests.funFact: Your toes help you steer and turn smoothly when you run around a corner.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you flex to show off your strength, like a superhero -- it is also the one that squeezes and pulls to help every part of you move!
quests.question: Muscles
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They help every part of your body move!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Muscles are under your skin and squeeze together to help your body move!
quests.funFact: Your body has more than six hundred muscles working together!

quests.instruction: Find the body part where you buckle your belt around your trousers and touch it!
quests.question: Waist
quests.hint: Think about this: It is between your chest and your hips.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Waist is the middle part of your body, between your chest and your hips!
quests.funFact: A hula hoop spins right around this part of your body.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that forms a hard, smooth tip at the end of each finger and touch it!
quests.question: Fingernails
quests.hint: Think about this: You trim these to keep them short.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Fingernails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each finger and protects it!
quests.funFact: Fingernails help protect the sensitive tips of your fingers.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part you can count as hard, curved lines if you press gently on your chest!
quests.question: Ribs
quests.hint: Hint: You can feel them if you press gently on your chest.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Ribs curve around your chest like a cage and protect your heart and lungs!
quests.funFact: Ribs keep your heart and lungs safe from bumps.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that gets extra protection when you wear a real bike helmet!
quests.question: Skull
quests.hint: Hint: It gives your head its round shape.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Skull is the hard bone inside your head that protects your brain!
quests.funFact: Your skull is actually made of several bones joined together.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that lets you blow out all the candles on a birthday cake!
quests.question: Lungs
quests.hint: Hint: You use these to blow out candles.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Lungs fill up with air when you breathe and let you blow things up!
quests.funFact: Deep breaths fill your lungs with plenty of fresh air.
